responsibility: This definition module declares the comment-tracking abstraction used by mc to preserve source comments across lexing and parsing. It defines the opaque comment descriptor plus helpers to start a comment block, append raw text, classify comments as procedure-heading/body/after-statement forms, and retrieve stored content in string or C-string form for later attachment to AST nodes and pretty-printed output.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the Modula-2 interface for the mcComment stem, declaring the commentDesc abstraction and comment classification/retrieval procedures; unlike the same-named .mod file it does not define storage or classification logic, and unlike the .h file it is not the C lexer bridge.
